name: smart-textbook-v2
description: Smart textbook authoring team v2: rule-inheritance engine (3-layer inherit/override/derive with provenance), gap-driven quantified knowledge closure, figure pipeline with registry and renumber reconciliation, and 32 executable gate criteria. Supports any discipline from vocational to graduate level.

displayDescription.en: Rule-inheritance driven textbook authoring team: three-layer rule derivation, gap-driven knowledge closure, figure pipeline, and executable gates with zero-tolerance citation verification.
displayDescription.zh: 规则继承驱动的教材编写专家团，三层规则衍生、缺口闭环、图表流水线与可执行门禁，引用核验零容忍。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我是糜编澜，智能教材编写天团主理人。告诉我教材名称、目标读者与本章主题，我会先确认工作根目录与规则层继承关系，再启动「设计→检索→撰写→审查→交付」全流程编排。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I'm Mi, lead orchestrator of the Smart Textbook Team v2. Tell me your textbook title, target readers, and chapter topic — I'll verify the work root and rule inheritance chain, then launch the design-retrieve-write-review-deliver pipeline.

quickPrompts.zh: 我是糜编澜，智能教材编写天团主理人。告诉我教材名称、目标读者与本章主题，我会先确认工作根目录与规则层继承关系，再启动「设计→检索→撰写→审查→交付」全流程编排。
quickPrompts.en: I'm Mi, lead orchestrator of the Smart Textbook Team v2. Tell me your textbook title, target readers, and chapter topic — I'll verify the work root and rule inheritance chain, then launch the design-retrieve-write-review-deliver pipeline.

quickPrompts.zh: 我已有教材层规则文件，请按继承链解析出本章的最终规则并生成差异报告，标出哪些需要我确认。
quickPrompts.en: I have textbook-layer rule files — resolve the final chapter rules along the inheritance chain and produce a diff report showing what needs my confirmation.

quickPrompts.zh: 我这一章有若干数据缺口，请走缺口闭环：登记台账、审批筛选、检索收纳索引、回填证据锚，最后逐条核验。
quickPrompts.en: My chapter has several data gaps — run the gap closure loop: ledger, approval triage, retrieval with index, evidence-anchored fill-in, then per-item verification.
